# Akinox Solutions

> > Akinox delivers AI-powered digital health platforms for governments and healthcare providers across Canada, specializing in pandemic response, primary care coordination, and public health technology.

Based in Québec, Akinox develops enterprise healthcare solutions including Pandemix (pandemic response and contact tracing), CarePath (primary care coordination), and Digimatix (public health infrastructure). The company partners with the ministère de la Santé et des Services sociaux (MSSS) and other government agencies to deliver mission-critical health technology across Canada.
